explanation: Each step multiplies the energy by about 32, so a magnitude 8 releases about 1,000 times the energy of a magnitude 6. The tenfold rule describes the size of the ground motion recorded.

claims.text: Each increase of one whole unit of earthquake magnitude corresponds to about 32 times more energy released.
One whole magnitude step multiplies the energy by about 32, not by 2, 10 or 100.
A magnitude 8 earthquake releases about 1,000 times the energy of a magnitude 6.
Each whole step in magnitude corresponds to about ten times larger ground-motion amplitude on a seismogram.
